OUR VISION

Empowering Every Child to Reach Their Fullest Potential

We, at Indian Public School, recognize that each child is an individual and respect the individual needs of children. With a stress on the total development of each child – moral, intellectual, social, emotional, physical and spiritual – we aim to provide students with the skills and exploratory experiences that shall enable them to reach their fullest potential as independent thinkers in order to adapt and adjust to a diverse and ever-changing world and lead a healthy, productive and meaningful life.


01

Holistic Development

Student development is catalyzed across intellectual, social, emotional, physical, spiritual and aesthetic qualities.

02

Lifelong Learning

We use the latest educational techniques to create the best learning experience and encourage a lifelong pursuit of knowledge.

03

Growth & Guidance

Student growth is promoted through empowerment, school teams, career guidance and counselling.

04

Nine Essential Life Skills

We nurture decision making, problem solving, critical thinking, effective communication, interpersonal relationships, self-awareness, empathy, self-esteem and stress handling.

05

Sports & Creative Excellence

Holistic development is encouraged through excellence in sports and enrichment through creative and performing arts.

06

Responsible Global Citizens

We instil the right attitude and approach for a happy, balanced life while preparing children to become responsible global citizens with strong professional skills and appreciation for the environment.

OUR IDENTITY

An Indian Mind. An Indian Heart. An Indian Soul.

We celebrate a culture of excellence and values, nurturing students with a strong connection to Indian heritage while preparing them for the opportunities and responsibilities of the modern world.

IPS
OUR MISSION

Challenge, Support & Inspire

We strive to provide within a student-centred, safe, supportive, challenging environment, a well-balanced instructional program that will empower children to reach their educational and personal potential while nurturing their self-confidence and self-esteem.

We seek to help each child discover and hone their innate talents and instil high standards for academic scholarship, integrity, leadership, cooperation, respect for individual differences and community values, compassion for others, civic mindedness, courage to act on their beliefs and responsible citizenship.

“Our mission, simply put, is to challenge and support students to be the best they can be.”
01

Academic Excellence

To provide students with a learning environment and strengthen a culture of academic excellence.

02

All-Round Development

To support students' all-round development through character building, teamwork, physical development and a strong sense of leadership.

03

Indian Values

To illuminate students' intellect in multi-dimensional ways, preparing them for advanced academic study without compromising rich Indian values.

Building the Leaders of Tomorrow

At Indian Public School, every child is encouraged to learn, discover, grow and contribute — with confidence, compassion and strong values.

Learn Grow Lead

Our Academic Framework

Learning with Purpose

Indian Public School is affiliated to The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) .

The Central Board of Secondary Education, established in 1929, enjoys the distinction of being one of the oldest and largest Boards of Secondary Education in India. It has about 15,000 affiliated schools in India and across 24 other countries of the world.

CBSE affiliated schools follow a uniform curriculum with a flexible scheme of studies suitable to the needs of each and every student.

The CBSE framework provides students and schools with common academic standards while allowing flexibility to meet individual learning needs.

The CBSE envisions a robust, vibrant and holistic school education that will engender excellence in every sphere of human endeavour. The Board is committed to providing quality education to promote intellectual, social and cultural vivacity among its learners.

It works towards evolving a learning process and environment which empowers future citizens to become global leaders in the emerging knowledge society.

Future Ready

Learners are encouraged to become confident and enterprising citizens who contribute to harmony and peace.

Indian Public School

Levels of Education

A progressive learning journey designed to nurture children at every stage of their academic, personal and social development.

Learning Journey

Learning That Grows With Every Child

At Indian Public School, learning is planned according to the age, abilities and developmental needs of students. Each level follows an approach that encourages academic growth, creativity, confidence, discipline and practical life skills.

From the playful and activity-based environment of the Pre-Primary years to the focused academic preparation of the Senior Secondary level, students below 18 are guided through a balanced and progressive educational journey.

Our Academic Structure

Four Stages of Learning

Every stage is designed to develop the right combination of knowledge, skills, values and confidence for school-age students.

01

Pre-Primary

Playgroup to Class UKG

Learning through activities, creativity, life skills, values and joyful experiences.

02

Primary

Class I to Class V

Strong foundations supported by teaching aids, activities, projects and awareness-building tools.

03

Middle Level

Class VI to Class VIII

Research-oriented, enquiry-based learning with practical and collaborative experiences.

04

Senior Secondary

Class IX to Class XII

Academic excellence, practical skills and preparation for competitive examinations.

Playgroup to UKG

Pre-Primary Level

The early years focus on joyful learning, communication, creativity, values and essential life skills.

Montessori Trained Teachers

Experienced teachers with a proven track record.

Activity-Based Curriculum

Curriculum blended with activities, life skills and moral values.

Educational Tours

Regular educational tours to make learning experiential.

Project Work

Class projects encourage mass participation.

Field Trips & Excursions

Learning becomes fun through real-world experiences.

Home Visits

Teachers connect with students and families through home visits.

Yoga & Meditation

Activities that encourage calmness, focus and well-being.

Language Practice

Reading, writing and conversational English practice.

Activity & Workshop Classes

Activity classes, workshop classes and monthly competitions encourage participation and confidence.

Class I to V

Primary Level

The primary years strengthen academic foundations while keeping learning active, engaging and connected to the world around students.

Qualified & Experienced Teachers

Highly qualified and experienced teachers with a proven track record.

Teaching Aids

Extensive use of teaching aids to supplement classroom teaching.

Projects & Activities

Project work and classroom activities ensure mass participation.

Field Trips

Field trips and excursions make classroom learning more enjoyable.

Learning Tools & General Awareness

Newspaper articles, quizzes, crosswords and other learning tools are used to enhance general awareness.

Class VI to VIII

Middle Level

The Middle Level builds upon the structured, student-centred and enquiry-based foundation developed during the Primary years.

01

Research-Oriented Curriculum

Learning opportunities are provided through worksheets, laboratory time, library time, computer time and small-group discussions.

02

Personality Development

Academic knowledge, questioning ability, sensory experiences and creative expression contribute to the overall development of students.

03

Group Learning

Story time, lecture demonstrations, large-group discussions, conceptual explanations and goal setting encourage collaboration.

04

Enquiry-Based Learning

Students are encouraged to question, explore, investigate and develop deeper understanding through practical experiences.

Class IX to XII

Senior Secondary Level

The Senior Secondary programme focuses on academic excellence, practical skills, competitive preparation and the overall development of students.

01

Academic & Practical Skills

The emphasis is laid not merely on information, but also on learning academic and practical skills.

02

Academic Excellence & Life Balance

The specialised programme strives to achieve a balance between academic excellence and life beyond scholastic aptitudes.

03

CBSE & Competitive Examinations

Equal emphasis is given to the prescribed CBSE syllabus and preparation for various competitive entrance examinations.

04

Result-Oriented Training

Experienced professionals provide focused training aimed at total development and desired academic success.

05

Synchro-Study

A synchronized study pattern connects board examination content with competitive entrance examination preparation to help reduce student stress.

06

Laboratories & Library Resources

Students have access to laboratories and library resources designed for senior-level study and research requirements.

07

Regular Doubt Removal Classes

Regular doubt-removal classes provide students with additional academic support and clarification.

08

In-House Competitive Preparation

In-house coaching support is provided for IIT, NEET, CLAT and CPT preparation.

Senior Secondary Focus

Preparing Students for Their Next Step

At the Senior Secondary level, students receive opportunities to strengthen academic understanding, practical knowledge, examination skills and confidence for future academic and professional pursuits.

From the first steps of joyful learning to focused senior-level preparation, Indian Public School aims to provide students below 18 with meaningful opportunities to learn, explore, participate and prepare for the future.

<div class="ips-methodology-page">

  <style>
    .ips-methodology-page {
      --ips-blue: #123B70;
      --ips-dark-blue: #082A52;
      --ips-yellow: #F4C430;
      --ips-bg: #f4f8fd;
      --ips-text: #172033;
      --ips-muted: #64748b;
      --ips-border: #dce6f2;

      width: 100%;
      color: var(--ips-text);
      font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page *,
    .ips-methodology-page *::before,
    .ips-methodology-page *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page h1,
    .ips-methodology-page h2,
    .ips-methodology-page h3,
    .ips-methodology-page p {
      margin: 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-page img {
      display: block;
      max-width: 100%;
    }

    /* =========================
       COMMON
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-container {
      width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 48px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-label {
      display: inline-block;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      line-height: 1.4;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .ips-methodology-title {
      margin-top: 10px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }

    .ips-methodology-line {
      width: 72px;
      height: 5px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-description {
      margin-top: 22px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    /* =========================
       HERO
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 290px;
      height: 290px;
      left: -110px;
      top: -120px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 330px;
      height: 330px;
      right: -140px;
      bottom: -170px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(244 196 48 / 0.4);
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.10);
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-title {
      margin-top: 22px !important;
      max-width: 850px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.4rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-title span {
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-hero-text {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin-top: 24px !important;
      color: #dbeafe;
      font-size: 1.12rem;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    /* =========================
       INTRO
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-intro {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-intro-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 70px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap {
      position: relative;
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 115px;
      height: 115px;
      left: -20px;
      bottom: -22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.28);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-wrap::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      right: -18px;
      top: -18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgb(18 59 112 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-card {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 8px solid #fff;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.14);
    }

    .ips-methodology-image-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 430px;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--ips-yellow);
      border-radius: 0 16px 16px 0;
      background: rgb(18 59 112 / 0.05);
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-highlight p {
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.94rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* =========================
       4Cs
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-skills {
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center {
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center .ips-methodology-line {
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-heading-center .ips-methodology-description {
      max-width: 700px;
      margin-left: auto !important;
      margin-right: auto !important;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skills-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 25px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-7px);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 35px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.10);
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 55px;
      height: 55px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card h3 {
      margin-top: 20px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .ips-methodology-skill-card p {
      margin-top: 9px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* =========================
       METHODOLOGY HIGHLIGHTS
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-highlights {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-section-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.20);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-methods-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 27px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.09);
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-number {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex: 0 0 48px;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card h3 {
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .ips-methodology-method-card p {
      margin-top: 8px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.89rem;
      line-height: 1.72;
    }

    .ips-methodology-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 7px;
      margin-top: 17px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: #eff6ff;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 0.69rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* =========================
       LEARNING MODEL
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-learning {
      background: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 70px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-label {
      color: var(--ips-yellow);
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-title {
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ips-methodology-learning .ips-methodology-description {
      color: #dbeafe;
    }

    .ips-methodology-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12);
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.055);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgb(244 196 48 / 0.5);
    }

    .ips-methodology-step-number {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step h3 {
      margin-top: 15px !important;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-step p {
      margin-top: 6px !important;
      color: #bfdbfe;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* =========================
       PROGRESS EVALUATION
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-evaluation {
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-box {
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 32px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.09);
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.4fr 0.6fr;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left {
      padding: 48px;
      background: var(--ips-blue);
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      border-radius: 17px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left h2 {
      margin-top: 25px !important;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-left p {
      margin-top: 18px !important;
      color: #dbeafe;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right {
      padding: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right h3 {
      margin-top: 10px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .ips-methodology-evaluation-right > p {
      margin-top: 17px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .ips-methodology-levels {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: #f8fafc;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--ips-blue);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-level span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }

    /* =========================
       CORE VALUES
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-values {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 82px 0;
    }

    .ips-methodology-values-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card {
      padding: 26px 22px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ips-border);
      border-radius: 23px;
      background: #fff;
      text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08);
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 50px;
      height: 50px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card h3 {
      margin-top: 17px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-value-card p {
      margin-top: 7px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      font-size: 0.83rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* =========================
       FINAL
    ========================== */

    .ips-methodology-final {
      padding: 82px 0;
      background: var(--ips-bg);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-inner {
      max-width: 820px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-icon {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.12);
    }

    .ips-methodology-final h2 {
      margin-top: 25px !important;
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final p {
      margin-top: 18px !important;
      color: var(--ips-muted);
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 19px;
      border-radius: 50px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag-blue {
      background: var(--ips-blue);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ips-methodology-final-tag-yellow {
      background: var(--ips-yellow);
      color: var(--ips-dark-blue);
    }

    /* =========================
       LARGE TABLET
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 1050px) {
      .ips-methodology-container {
        width: min(100% - 40px, 920px);
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro-grid,
      .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
        gap: 45px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-skills-grid,
      .ips-methodology-values-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    /* =========================
       TABLET
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 850px) {
      .ips-methodology-hero {
        padding: 68px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro,
      .ips-methodology-skills,
      .ips-methodology-highlights,
      .ips-methodology-learning,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation,
      .ips-methodology-values,
      .ips-methodology-final {
        padding: 65px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro-grid,
      .ips-methodology-learning-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 50px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-card img {
        height: 390px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-methods-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-left,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation-right {
        padding: 38px;
      }
    }

    /* =========================
       MOBILE
    ========================== */

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .ips-methodology-container {
        width: calc(100% - 30px);
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero {
        padding: 55px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-badge {
        padding: 8px 13px;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-title {
        margin-top: 18px !important;
        font-size: 2.4rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-hero-text {
        margin-top: 18px !important;
        font-size: 0.96rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .ips-methodology-intro,
      .ips-methodology-skills,
      .ips-methodology-highlights,
      .ips-methodology-learning,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation,
      .ips-methodology-values,
      .ips-methodology-final {
        padding: 55px 0;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-wrap::before {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        left: -10px;
        bottom: -10px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-wrap::after {
        width: 65px;
        height: 65px;
        right: -8px;
        top: -8px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-card {
        border-width: 5px;
        border-radius: 22px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-image-card img {
        height: 300px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-description {
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.75;
      }

      .ips-methodology-skills-grid,
      .ips-methodology-values-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 15px;
        margin-top: 32px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-skill-card {
        padding: 23px;
        border-radius: 21px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-methods-grid {
        margin-top: 32px;
        gap: 14px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-method-card {
        gap: 13px;
        padding: 20px;
        border-radius: 20px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-method-number {
        flex-basis: 42px;
        width: 42px;
        height: 42px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-method-card h3 {
        font-size: 1rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-method-card p {
        font-size: 0.84rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-tags {
        gap: 5px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-tag {
        font-size: 0.64rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-steps {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-step {
        padding: 21px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-box {
        border-radius: 24px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-left,
      .ips-methodology-evaluation-right {
        padding: 28px 22px;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-left h2 {
        font-size: 1.8rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-evaluation-right h3 {
        font-size: 1.35rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-levels {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ips-methodology-final h2 {
        font-size: 2rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-final p {
        font-size: 0.92rem;
      }

      .ips-methodology-final-tag {
        padding: 9px 15px;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 380px) {
      .ips-methodology-container {
        width: calc(100% - 24px);
      }

      .ips-methodology-method-card {
        flex-direction: column;
      }
    }
  </style>


  <!-- HERO -->
  <div class="ips-methodology-hero">
    <div class="ips-methodology-container ips-methodology-hero-inner">

      <span class="ips-methodology-hero-badge">
        <i class="bi bi-lightbulb-fill"></i>
        Learning • Growth • Development
      </span>

      <h1 class="ips-methodology-hero-title">
        Teaching <span>Methodology</span>

      <p class="ips-methodology-hero-text">

Challenge • Perform • Excel

The Spirit of Competition

Bringing Out the Best in Students

Competition in any form brings out the best in people and pushes them to excel. In schools, if used effectively, it can enhance learning significantly.

Competition in the classroom can be healthy and should be encouraged when it motivates students to extend themselves, explore their real capabilities and maximize their true potential.

Healthy Competition

It allows students to stretch their abilities while recognizing their strengths and areas where they can continue to improve.

Why Competition Matters

Turning Challenge Into Growth

When used effectively, competition can help students understand their capabilities and encourage them to work towards their personal best.

Extend Yourself

Students are encouraged to go beyond their comfort zone and challenge their existing abilities.

Discover Potential

Healthy challenges help students recognize and maximize their true potential.

Measure Progress

Students can evaluate their own performance and identify areas for improvement.

Strive for Excellence

Competition can motivate students to put consistent effort into their learning and activities.

Classroom Competition

A Healthy Drive to Perform Better

Traditionally, schools have fostered competition among students by assigning positions at the end of the term or semester.

Each student may be assigned a position based on the average score obtained from an aggregate of tests and assignment scores. Some schools also recognize positions by individual subjects as well as overall class performance.

This gives students an opportunity to understand their performance in different areas and compare their progress with the expectations of their learning environment.

01

Overall Performance

Understanding overall academic progress.

02

Subject Strengths

Recognizing individual areas of strength.

03

Continuous Effort

Encouraging students to maintain consistent effort.

Self Evaluation

Know Your Strength. Improve Your Game.

Students are able to match their abilities against those of their classmates and understand where they stand in their learning journey.

Through this process, students can evaluate their own competencies and recognize areas where they need to put in greater effort.

01

Evaluate

Understand your current performance.

02

Identify

Recognize strengths and challenges.

03

Improve

Decide where more effort is required.

04

Excel

Work consistently towards excellence.

The IPS Approach

Competition as a Journey of Continuous Improvement

The purpose of competition is not simply to identify who is at the top. It can also encourage students to understand their abilities, set goals, put in effort and continue improving over time.

Challenge

Take on challenges that encourage you to extend your abilities.

Effort

Put consistent effort into learning and improving performance.

Growth

Use experience to recognize progress and continue moving forward.

Compete With Purpose. Grow With Confidence.

At IPS, healthy competition encourages students to recognize their abilities, develop consistent effort and strive towards their highest potential.

All students must know Class 12 boards are crucial to crack if you want to do well in your entrance exams. This marks the beginning of your journey towards your dream college.

Let’s take a detailed look at your 1-month study plan if you want to know how to prepare CBSE board exam in one month.

30-Day Study Plan

Finish the Syllabus. Revise. Practise.

Given below is a sample timetable to finish the whole syllabus and prepare for the exam in 30 days.

30-Day Subject-Wise Preparation Plan

Days Subjects & Preparation
1–5 Physics – Keep the complete list of formulae, experiments, and derivations.
6–9 Chemistry – Questions related to organic and inorganic chemistry are fact-based questions that can be solved quickly with good practice.
10–15 Maths – Firstly, clear the basic fundamentals and concepts of the subject. Some calculations can be lengthy, so you should practise a lot of these types of questions.
16–18 English – Read as much as you can. Any piece of good literature should not escape your hands: your textbooks, the newspaper, or anything else you can lay your hands on. Follow a good grammar book and know the basic rules.
19–22 Biology / Computer Science – The key to a successful Computer Science or Biology exam is understanding. Be thorough with the diagrams and important terminologies.
23–27 Revision Days – Dedicate each day to a particular subject and revise according to your preparation needs.
27–30 Sample & Previous Year Papers – Solve sample papers or previous years' papers to improve speed, accuracy and exam readiness.

Smart Preparation

Make Your One Month Count

01

One Subject at a Time

Create a schedule for one subject at a time. You could modify it as per your preferences.

02

Set a Specific Study Time

Try and set a specific time to study every day and you’ll find that it makes things so much easier.

03

Practise Regularly

Regular practice helps strengthen concepts, improve speed and build confidence before the examination.

04

Focus on Your Goal

Remember that the grades you get in the 12th board exams do matter and they determine, to a large extent, your career graph.

Your Future Starts Here

Prepare Today for Your Dream College

Class 12 boards can be an important milestone in your academic journey. A focused plan, consistent practice and effective revision can help you approach the examination with greater confidence.

Plan • Practise • Revise
30 Days

All the Best!

Stay focused, follow your plan and give your best effort throughout your preparation.
